---- MODULE AuthGateTrace ----
\* Trace wrapper for AuthGate.tla (U09). tests/bun/bridge.ts generates TraceObs
\* from the records of one remote (instance "remote").
\*
\* Mapping from the Zig core (src/mcp/core/auth.zig, Gate):
\*   - Each record is one action, named as in the model in snake_case, with
\*     its parameters in the data (`expiring`, `rotate`, `refreshable`).
\*   - `key` is the request's U02 id or the auxiliary key; Keys are those the
\*     trace names. The record carries the subject's entry after the step;
\*     other entries follow from the step.
\*   - The server's choices (Expire) aren't traced: they may happen between
\*     records.
\*   - A record marked `ignored` is accepted only where the model's action is
\*     disabled, and nothing may change.
EXTENDS AuthGate, TraceObs, Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

VARIABLE i

Recs == {ObsTrace[n] : n \in 1..Len(ObsTrace)}
ObsKeys == {r.data.key : r \in {x \in Recs : x.data.key # 0}}
ObsGens == {r.data.gen : r \in Recs} \cup {1}
ObsMaxGen == CHOOSE m \in ObsGens : \A g \in ObsGens : g <= m

Step(r) ==
    CASE r.event = "send" -> Send(r.data.key, r.data.expiring)
      [] r.event = "accept" -> Accept(r.data.key)
      [] r.event = "reject" -> Reject(r.data.key)
      [] r.event = "forget" -> Forget(r.data.key)
      [] r.event = "refresh_ok" -> RefreshOk(r.data.rotate)
      [] r.event = "refresh_refused" -> RefreshRefused
      [] r.event = "refresh_failed" -> RefreshFailed
      [] r.event = "signed_in" -> SignedIn(r.data.refreshable)
      [] r.event = "sign_out" -> SignOut
      [] OTHER -> FALSE

Matches(r) ==
    /\ gen' = r.data.gen
    /\ held' = r.data.held
    /\ refreshable' = r.data.refreshable
    /\ rt' = r.data.rt
    /\ inflight' = IF r.data.refreshing THEN 1 ELSE 0
    /\ r.data.key # 0 =>
          /\ req'[r.data.key].phase = r.to
          /\ req'[r.data.key].g = r.data.g
          /\ req'[r.data.key].again = r.data.again

TraceInit ==
    /\ Init
    /\ i = 0

TraceNext ==
    \/ /\ i < Len(ObsTrace)
       /\ LET r == ObsTrace[i + 1]
          IN /\ (r.data.key # 0 => req[r.data.key].phase = r.from)
             /\ IF r.data.ignored THEN ~ENABLED Step(r) /\ UNCHANGED vars ELSE Step(r)
             /\ Matches(r)
       /\ i' = i + 1
    \/ /\ \E g \in valid : Expire(g)
       /\ UNCHANGED i

\* Sentinel: violated exactly when every observed step has been matched.
NotDone == i < Len(ObsTrace)
====

\* Stress bounds: two issuers, two scopes, five sign-ins against a bound of three.
CONSTANTS
    Issuers = {i1, i2}
    None = none
    Scopes = {s1, s2}
    MaxFlows = 5
    MaxAuthorizations = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT MetaValidated
INVARIANT RedeemGuard
INVARIANT VerifierOnce
INVARIANT ErrSuppress
INVARIANT CredIsolation
INVARIANT TokenAudience
INVARIANT ScopeUnion
INVARIANT StepUpBound
PROPERTY EverySignInEnds

------------------------------ MODULE AuthTrace ------------------------------
(* Replays a run of the real authorizer through ProviderAuth's own Next. Each
   step must produce exactly the next observed event. TLC breaking
   NotAllMatched means every event matched; finishing the search without
   breaking it means the run diverged from the model. *)
EXTENDS ProviderAuth, AuthObserved, Sequences, TLC

VARIABLE i

TraceInit == Init /\ i = 0

TraceNext ==
  /\ i < Len(Observed)
  /\ Next
  /\ ev' = Observed[i + 1]
  /\ i' = i + 1

TraceSpec == TraceInit /\ [][TraceNext]_<<vars, i>>

NotAllMatched == i < Len(Observed)

\* Prints how far the replay got, so a divergence names its event.
Matched == PrintT(<<"AUTH_MATCHED", i>>)
=============================================================================

---- MODULE AuthFlowTrace ----
\* Trace wrapper for AuthFlow.tla (U09). tests/bun/bridge.ts generates TraceObs
\* from the records of one remote (instance "remote").
\*
\* Mapping from the Zig core (src/mcp/core/auth.zig, Flow):
\*   - Each record is one action, named as in the model in snake_case, with
\*     its parameters in the data. `discovered` with issuer 0 is a discovery
\*     whose metadata failed a check; otherwise both checks passed.
\*   - Issuers are the host's numbers from 1, and None is 0. Scope sets are
\*     bit masks.
\*   - The resource metadata naming another server (Migrate) isn't traced; it
\*     may happen between records.
\*   - A record marked `ignored` is accepted only where the model's action is
\*     disabled, and nothing may change.
\*   - MaxAuthorizations comes from the scenario (ObsMaxAuthorizations).
EXTENDS AuthFlow, TraceObs, Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

VARIABLE i

Recs == {ObsTrace[n] : n \in 1..Len(ObsTrace)}
ObsIssuerSet == {r.data.issuer : r \in Recs} \cup {r.data.flow_issuer : r \in Recs} \cup {r.data.token_issuer : r \in Recs} \cup {1}
ObsMaxIssuer == CHOOSE m \in ObsIssuerSet : \A x \in ObsIssuerSet : x <= m
ObsIssuers == 1..ObsMaxIssuer
ObsNone == 0
ObsMasks == {r.data.scopes : r \in Recs} \cup {r.data.flow_scopes : r \in Recs} \cup {r.data.granted : r \in Recs} \cup {r.data.challenge : r \in Recs}
ObsMaxMask == CHOOSE m \in ObsMasks : \A x \in ObsMasks : x <= m
\* Scope masks use bits 0..30 (src/mcp/auth/oauth.zig max_scopes): 2^31 is past
\* TLC's integers.
ObsScopes == {b \in 0..30 : 2^b <= ObsMaxMask}
ObsFlowSet == {r.data.flows : r \in Recs} \cup {1}
ObsMaxFlows == CHOOSE m \in ObsFlowSet : \A x \in ObsFlowSet : x <= m

Bits(m) == {b \in Scopes : (m \div (2^b)) % 2 = 1}
Regs(m) == {x \in Issuers : (m \div (2^(x - 1))) % 2 = 1}

Step(r) ==
    CASE r.event = "sign_in" -> SignIn
      [] r.event = "discovered" ->
            IF r.data.issuer = 0
            THEN \E m, p \in BOOLEAN : ~(m /\ p) /\ Discovered(m, p, Bits(r.data.scopes))
            ELSE asIssuer = r.data.issuer /\ Discovered(TRUE, TRUE, Bits(r.data.scopes))
      [] r.event = "registered" -> Registered(r.data.ok)
      [] r.event = "responded" -> Responded(r.data.state_ok, r.data.iss, r.data.advertised, r.data.err)
      [] r.event = "redeemed" -> Redeemed(r.data.ok)
      [] r.event = "cancel" -> Cancel
      [] r.event = "signed_out" -> SignOut
      [] r.event = "challenged" -> Challenged(Bits(r.data.scopes))
      [] r.event = "accepted" -> Accepted
      [] OTHER -> FALSE

Matches(r) ==
    /\ flow' = r.to
    /\ flows' = r.data.flows
    /\ flowIssuer' = r.data.flow_issuer
    /\ flowScopes' = Bits(r.data.flow_scopes)
    /\ regs' = Regs(r.data.regs)
    /\ tokenIssuer' = r.data.token_issuer
    /\ granted' = Bits(r.data.granted)
    /\ challenge' = Bits(r.data.challenge)
    /\ auths' = r.data.auths

TraceInit ==
    /\ Init
    /\ i = 0

TraceNext ==
    \/ /\ i < Len(ObsTrace)
       /\ LET r == ObsTrace[i + 1]
          IN /\ flow = r.from
             /\ IF r.data.ignored THEN ~ENABLED Step(r) /\ UNCHANGED vars ELSE Step(r)
             /\ Matches(r)
       /\ i' = i + 1
    \/ /\ Migrate
       /\ UNCHANGED i

\* Sentinel: violated exactly when every observed step has been matched.
NotDone == i < Len(ObsTrace)
====

---- MODULE AuthFlow ----
\* U09 signing in, client side, for one MCP server: discovery, registration,
\* the authorization request and its response, and redeeming the code.
\* Rules: AUTH-03..AUTH-17, AUTH-23 (rules.md). The token on requests is
\* AuthGate.tla.
\*
\*   - Discovery finds the authorization server the resource metadata names.
\*     Its metadata is used only when its issuer is the one the URL was built
\*     from and it lists S256 (AUTH-06, AUTH-07); otherwise the sign-in fails.
\*   - Registrations are kept per issuer: one is presented only to the issuer
\*     that issued it, and a new issuer gets a new one (AUTH-08). The token held
\*     is dropped when the metadata names another issuer.
\*   - The issuer is recorded with the flow's verifier and state before the
\*     authorization request (AUTH-13). The response is checked for state and
\*     iss before anything else, and an error in a response that fails the
\*     checks is never shown (AUTH-14, AUTH-15). Each verifier is redeemed once.
\*   - A sign-in asks for the scopes the token held was asked with plus those of
\*     the latest challenge (AUTH-23). At most MaxAuthorizations authorization
\*     requests go out since the server last accepted a request.
\*
\* Issuers, scopes, and flows are small sets; their strings are data.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS
    Issuers,
    None,                \* no issuer
    Scopes,
    MaxFlows,            \* sign-ins per run
    MaxAuthorizations    \* authorization requests per sign-in; fx allows 3

ASSUME MaxFlows \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxAuthorizations \in Nat \ {0} /\ None \notin Issuers

Flows == {"idle", "discovering", "registering", "authorizing", "redeeming"}

VARIABLES
    flow,
    flows,        \* sign-ins started; each has its own verifier and state
    flowIssuer,   \* the issuer recorded with the flow's verifier and state
    flowScopes,   \* the scopes the flow asks for
    regs,         \* issuers the client holds a registration with
    tokenIssuer,  \* issuer of the token held, None for none
    granted,      \* the scopes the token held was asked with
    challenge,    \* the scopes the latest challenge named
    auths,        \* authorization requests since the server last accepted one
    \* Environment.
    asIssuer,     \* the authorization server the resource metadata names
    migrated,
    \* Ghosts.
    known,        \* issuer of the last metadata the client validated
    validated,    \* this flow's metadata passed the issuer and PKCE checks
    checked,      \* this flow's response passed the state and iss checks
    asked,        \* granted \cup challenge when this flow started
    shown,        \* an error from an unchecked response was shown
    redemptions,  \* [1..MaxFlows -> codes redeemed]
    used          \* <<registration's issuer, issuer it was presented to>>

vars == <<flow, flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, tokenIssuer, granted, challenge, auths,
          asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions, used>>

Init ==
    /\ flow = "idle"
    /\ flows = 0
    /\ flowIssuer = None
    /\ flowScopes = {}
    /\ regs = {}
    /\ tokenIssuer = None
    /\ granted = {}
    /\ challenge = {}
    /\ auths = 0
    /\ asIssuer \in Issuers
    /\ migrated = FALSE
    /\ known = None
    /\ validated = FALSE
    /\ checked = FALSE
    /\ asked = {}
    /\ shown = FALSE
    /\ redemptions = [f \in 1..MaxFlows |-> 0]
    /\ used = {}

\* ---- Client ----

\* The host asks to sign in: after a challenge, or to step up (AUTH-23).
SignIn ==
    /\ flow = "idle"
    /\ flows < MaxFlows
    /\ auths < MaxAuthorizations
    /\ flow' = "discovering"
    /\ flows' = flows + 1
    /\ flowScopes' = granted \cup challenge
    /\ asked' = granted \cup challenge
    /\ validated' = FALSE
    /\ checked' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flowIssuer, regs, tokenIssuer, granted, challenge, auths, asIssuer, migrated, known, shown, redemptions, used>>

\* The authorization request goes out, presenting registration `reg` to `i`.
Authorize(reg, i) ==
    /\ flow' = "authorizing"
    /\ auths' = auths + 1
    /\ used' = used \cup {<<reg, i>>}

\* Discovery ends: whether the metadata's issuer is the one the URL was built
\* from, whether it lists S256, and the resource metadata's scopes_supported,
\* asked for when nothing else names scopes (AUTH-12). Usable metadata names
\* the issuer the flow records.
Discovered(metaOk, pkceOk, defaults) ==
    /\ flow = "discovering"
    /\ LET usable == metaOk /\ pkceOk IN
       IF usable
       THEN /\ flowIssuer' = asIssuer
            /\ known' = asIssuer
            /\ validated' = (metaOk /\ pkceOk)
            /\ flowScopes' = IF flowScopes = {} THEN defaults ELSE flowScopes
            /\ IF tokenIssuer \notin {None, asIssuer}
               THEN tokenIssuer' = None /\ granted' = {}
               ELSE UNCHANGED <<tokenIssuer, granted>>
            /\ IF asIssuer \in regs
               THEN Authorize(asIssuer, asIssuer) /\ UNCHANGED regs
               ELSE flow' = "registering" /\ UNCHANGED <<regs, auths, used>>
       ELSE /\ flow' = "idle"
            /\ UNCHANGED <<flowIssuer, flowScopes, known, validated, tokenIssuer, granted, regs, auths, used>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flows, challenge, asIssuer, migrated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions>>

\* Registration with the flow's issuer ends.
Registered(ok) ==
    /\ flow = "registering"
    /\ IF ok
       THEN regs' = regs \cup {flowIssuer} /\ Authorize(flowIssuer, flowIssuer)
       ELSE flow' = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED <<regs, auths, used>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, tokenIssuer, granted, challenge, asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions>>

\* The host passes back the authorization response: whether its state matches,
\* its iss ("none", "match", "wrong"), whether the metadata advertised iss, and
\* whether it carries an error rather than a code (AUTH-14, AUTH-15).
Responded(stateOk, iss, advertised, err) ==
    /\ flow = "authorizing"
    /\ LET \* What RFC 9207 and the state check say about the response.
           passes == stateOk /\ (iss = "match" \/ (iss = "none" /\ ~advertised))
           \* The client's decision, and whether it shows the error.
           accept == stateOk /\ CASE iss = "match" -> TRUE
                                    [] iss = "wrong" -> FALSE
                                    [] iss = "none" -> ~advertised
           display == err /\ accept
       IN /\ checked' = passes
          /\ shown' = (shown \/ (display /\ ~passes))
          /\ flow' = IF accept /\ ~err THEN "redeeming" ELSE "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, tokenIssuer, granted, challenge, auths, asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, asked, redemptions, used>>

\* The token request with the flow's verifier ends.
Redeemed(ok) ==
    /\ flow = "redeeming"
    /\ redemptions' = [redemptions EXCEPT ![flows] = @ + 1]
    /\ flow' = "idle"
    /\ IF ok
       THEN tokenIssuer' = flowIssuer /\ granted' = flowScopes
       ELSE UNCHANGED <<tokenIssuer, granted>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, challenge, auths, asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, used>>

\* The host gives up waiting, or the sign-in is cancelled.
Cancel ==
    /\ flow # "idle"
    /\ flow' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, tokenIssuer, granted, challenge, auths, asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions, used>>

SignOut ==
    /\ tokenIssuer' = None
    /\ granted' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flow, flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, challenge, auths, asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions, used>>

\* ---- Environment ----

\* A request is rejected with a challenge naming these scopes.
Challenged(sc) ==
    /\ challenge' = sc
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flow, flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, tokenIssuer, granted, auths, asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions, used>>

\* The server accepts a request.
Accepted ==
    /\ tokenIssuer # None
    /\ auths' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flow, flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, tokenIssuer, granted, challenge, asIssuer, migrated, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions, used>>

\* The resource metadata starts naming another authorization server.
Migrate ==
    /\ ~migrated
    /\ \E i \in Issuers \ {asIssuer} : asIssuer' = i
    /\ migrated' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<flow, flows, flowIssuer, flowScopes, regs, tokenIssuer, granted, challenge, auths, known, validated, checked, asked, shown, redemptions, used>>

Progress ==
    \/ \E m, p \in BOOLEAN, d \in SUBSET Scopes : Discovered(m, p, d)
    \/ \E ok \in BOOLEAN : Registered(ok)
    \/ \E s, a, e \in BOOLEAN, i \in {"none", "match", "wrong"} : Responded(s, i, a, e)
    \/ \E ok \in BOOLEAN : Redeemed(ok)
    \/ Cancel

Next ==
    \/ SignIn
    \/ Progress
    \/ SignOut
    \/ \E sc \in SUBSET Scopes : Challenged(sc)
    \/ Accepted
    \/ Migrate

\* Every step of a sign-in gets an answer, or the host cancels it.
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Progress)

\* ---- Properties ----

TypeOK ==
    /\ flow \in Flows
    /\ flows \in 0..MaxFlows
    /\ regs \subseteq Issuers
    /\ tokenIssuer \in Issuers \cup {None}
    /\ granted \subseteq Scopes /\ challenge \subseteq Scopes /\ flowScopes \subseteq Scopes
    /\ auths \in Nat

\* AUTH-06, AUTH-07: nothing goes to an authorization server whose metadata
\* failed the issuer or PKCE check.
MetaValidated == flow \in {"registering", "authorizing", "redeeming"} => validated

\* AUTH-14, AUTH-15: a code is redeemed only from a response that passed the
\* state and iss checks.
RedeemGuard == flow = "redeeming" => checked

\* Each flow's verifier is redeemed at most once.
VerifierOnce == \A f \in 1..MaxFlows : redemptions[f] <= 1

\* AUTH-14: no error from a response that failed the checks is shown.
ErrSuppress == ~shown

\* AUTH-08: a registration is presented only to the issuer that issued it.
CredIsolation == \A p \in used : p[1] = p[2]

\* AUTH-20: the token held is always from the issuer the validated metadata
\* names, once the client has seen one.
TokenAudience == tokenIssuer \in {None, known}

\* AUTH-23: a sign-in asks for at least the scopes held and those challenged.
ScopeUnion == flow # "idle" => asked \subseteq flowScopes

\* Authorization requests are bounded.
StepUpBound == auths <= MaxAuthorizations

\* Every sign-in ends.
EverySignInEnds == flow # "idle" ~> flow = "idle"
====

---- MODULE AuthGate ----
\* U09 the credential gate, client side: the requests to one MCP server and
\* the token they carry. Rules: AUTH-19, AUTH-22, AUTH-25 (rules.md).
\* Signing in is AuthFlow.tla.
\*
\*   - A token is named by its generation: each sign-in or refresh brings the
\*     next one. Every request carries the token held, if any (AUTH-19).
\*   - The server accepts some generations. A request with an expired token,
\*     or none, is rejected with 401 before the server reads it, so the client
\*     sends it again, once, with a newer token: at once if one arrived since
\*     it went out, else after a refresh. Without a refresh token, or when the
\*     second send is rejected too, it ends needing sign-in.
\*   - One refresh at a time. A request that would go out during a
\*     refresh, or with a token close to expiry, waits for it.
\*   - The refresh token may rotate, and the client always presents the latest
\*     (AUTH-25). A refusal drops both tokens; a transport failure keeps them
\*     and fails the requests waiting.
\*   - Signing in brings a new token; signing out cancels the refresh in flight.
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS
    Keys,     \* requests
    MaxGen    \* tokens per run

ASSUME MaxGen \in Nat \ {0}

Phases == {"idle", "sent", "waiting", "done", "needs_sign_in", "failed", "cancelled"}

VARIABLES
    gen,          \* generation of the newest token, 0 before the first
    held,         \* a token is held
    refreshable,  \* a refresh token is held
    rt,           \* the refresh token held, by the generation that brought it
    inflight,     \* refreshes in flight
    req,          \* [Keys -> [phase, g: the token it carries, again: a second send]]
    \* Server.
    valid,        \* generations the server accepts; 0 when it needs no token
    serverRt,     \* the refresh token the authorization server accepts
    \* Ghosts.
    usedRt,       \* the refresh token the refresh in flight presented
    sends,        \* [Keys -> times sent]
    rejectedG     \* [Keys -> the token its rejected send carried]

vars == <<gen, held, refreshable, rt, inflight, req, valid, serverRt, usedRt, sends, rejectedG>>

Init ==
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ held = FALSE
    /\ refreshable = FALSE
    /\ rt = 0
    /\ inflight = 0
    /\ req = [k \in Keys |-> [phase |-> "idle", g |-> 0, again |-> FALSE]]
    /\ valid \in {{}, {0}}
    /\ serverRt = 0
    /\ usedRt = 0
    /\ sends = [k \in Keys |-> 0]
    /\ rejectedG = [k \in Keys |-> 0]

Token == IF held THEN gen ELSE 0

\* ---- Client ----

\* A request goes out with the token held. During a refresh, or with a token
\* close to expiry and a refresh token, it waits for the refresh.
Send(k, expiring) ==
    /\ req[k].phase = "idle"
    /\ IF inflight > 0 \/ (expiring /\ held /\ refreshable)
       THEN /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "waiting"]
            /\ IF inflight = 0
               THEN inflight' = 1 /\ usedRt' = rt
               ELSE UNCHANGED <<inflight, usedRt>>
            /\ UNCHANGED sends
       ELSE /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "sent", ![k].g = Token]
            /\ sends' = [sends EXCEPT ![k] = @ + 1]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, usedRt>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, held, refreshable, rt, valid, serverRt, rejectedG>>

\* The server accepts the request.
Accept(k) ==
    /\ req[k].phase = "sent"
    /\ req[k].g \in valid
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, held, refreshable, rt, inflight, valid, serverRt, usedRt, sends, rejectedG>>

\* The server rejects it with 401.
Reject(k) ==
    /\ req[k].phase = "sent"
    /\ req[k].g \notin valid
    /\ rejectedG' = [rejectedG EXCEPT ![k] = req[k].g]
    /\ IF req[k].again
       THEN /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "needs_sign_in"]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, usedRt, sends>>
       ELSE IF Token > req[k].g
       THEN \* A newer token arrived since it went out.
            /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].g = Token, ![k].again = TRUE]
            /\ sends' = [sends EXCEPT ![k] = @ + 1]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, usedRt>>
       ELSE IF inflight > 0
       THEN /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "waiting", ![k].again = TRUE]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, usedRt, sends>>
       ELSE IF held /\ refreshable
       THEN /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "waiting", ![k].again = TRUE]
            /\ inflight' = 1
            /\ usedRt' = rt
            /\ UNCHANGED sends
       ELSE /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "needs_sign_in"]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, usedRt, sends>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, held, refreshable, rt, valid, serverRt>>

\* Waiting requests go out once the refresh ends with a token, or end.
Release(next) ==
    [k \in Keys |-> IF req[k].phase = "waiting" THEN [req[k] EXCEPT !.phase = next, !.g = gen + 1] ELSE req[k]]

Released(next) ==
    [k \in Keys |-> IF req[k].phase = "waiting" THEN sends[k] + 1 ELSE sends[k]]

\* The client gives up on a request: its timeout, or the host cancels it.
Forget(k) ==
    /\ req[k].phase \in {"sent", "waiting"}
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![k].phase = "cancelled"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, held, refreshable, rt, inflight, valid, serverRt, usedRt, sends, rejectedG>>

\* ---- Authorization server ----

\* A new token, and maybe a new refresh token (rotation, AUTH-25).
RefreshOk(rotate) ==
    /\ inflight > 0
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ held' = TRUE
    /\ valid' = valid \cup {gen + 1}
    /\ serverRt' = IF rotate THEN gen + 1 ELSE serverRt
    /\ rt' = IF rotate THEN gen + 1 ELSE rt
    /\ inflight' = 0
    /\ req' = Release("sent")
    /\ sends' = Released("sent")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<refreshable, usedRt, rejectedG>>

\* invalid_grant: both tokens are dropped.
RefreshRefused ==
    /\ inflight > 0
    /\ held' = FALSE
    /\ refreshable' = FALSE
    /\ inflight' = 0
    /\ req' = [k \in Keys |-> IF req[k].phase = "waiting" THEN [req[k] EXCEPT !.phase = "needs_sign_in"] ELSE req[k]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, rt, valid, serverRt, usedRt, sends, rejectedG>>

\* The refresh never got an answer: the tokens are kept.
RefreshFailed ==
    /\ inflight > 0
    /\ inflight' = 0
    /\ req' = [k \in Keys |-> IF req[k].phase = "waiting" THEN [req[k] EXCEPT !.phase = "failed"] ELSE req[k]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, held, refreshable, rt, valid, serverRt, usedRt, sends, rejectedG>>

\* ---- Environment ----

\* A token expires, or the server stops accepting it, or starts asking for one.
Expire(g) ==
    /\ g \in valid
    /\ valid' = valid \ {g}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, held, refreshable, rt, inflight, req, serverRt, usedRt, sends, rejectedG>>

\* A sign-in (AuthFlow.tla) brings a token, with or without a refresh token.
\* It replaces the refresh in flight, whose answer is ignored, and the requests
\* waiting go out with it.
SignedIn(withRefresh) ==
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ held' = TRUE
    /\ refreshable' = withRefresh
    /\ rt' = gen + 1
    /\ serverRt' = gen + 1
    /\ valid' = valid \cup {gen + 1}
    /\ inflight' = 0
    /\ req' = Release("sent")
    /\ sends' = Released("sent")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<usedRt, rejectedG>>

\* Signing out drops the tokens and cancels the refresh in flight.
SignOut ==
    /\ held' = FALSE
    /\ refreshable' = FALSE
    /\ inflight' = 0
    /\ req' = [k \in Keys |-> IF req[k].phase = "waiting" THEN [req[k] EXCEPT !.phase = "needs_sign_in"] ELSE req[k]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, rt, valid, serverRt, usedRt, sends, rejectedG>>

Answer(k) == Accept(k) \/ Reject(k)
Refreshed == (\E r \in BOOLEAN : RefreshOk(r)) \/ RefreshRefused \/ RefreshFailed

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in Keys, e \in BOOLEAN : Send(k, e)
    \/ \E k \in Keys : Answer(k) \/ Forget(k)
    \/ Refreshed
    \/ \E g \in valid : Expire(g)
    \/ \E r \in BOOLEAN : SignedIn(r)
    \/ SignOut

\* The server answers every request, and the authorization server every
\* refresh.
Fairness ==
    /\ \A k \in Keys : WF_vars(Answer(k))
    /\ WF_vars(Refreshed)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ Fairness

\* ---- Properties ----

TypeOK ==
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ held \in BOOLEAN /\ refreshable \in BOOLEAN
    /\ inflight \in Nat
    /\ \A k \in Keys : req[k].phase \in Phases /\ req[k].g \in 0..MaxGen /\ req[k].again \in BOOLEAN
    /\ valid \subseteq 0..MaxGen

\* One refresh at a time.
SingleFlightRefresh == inflight <= 1

\* AUTH-25: a refresh presents the refresh token the server accepts, the latest
\* one it issued.
RefreshUsesLatest == inflight > 0 => usedRt = serverRt

\* A request goes out at most twice, and its second send carries a newer
\* token than the one rejected.
SendsBound == \A k \in Keys : sends[k] <= 2
NewerOnResend == \A k \in Keys : (req[k].phase = "sent" /\ req[k].again) => req[k].g > rejectedG[k]

\* A request waits only while a refresh is in flight, so nothing waits forever.
WaitingHasRefresh == (\E k \in Keys : req[k].phase = "waiting") => inflight > 0

\* Every request ends: accepted, needing sign-in, failed, or cancelled.
EveryRequestEnds == \A k \in Keys : req[k].phase \in {"sent", "waiting"} ~> req[k].phase \in {"done", "needs_sign_in", "failed", "cancelled"}
====
